long_biography.plain_text:
Motor Oil placed Vardinogiannis at the center of its succession after decades under his father, Vardis. He had served as vice chairman and managing director before the board reorganized around him in November 2024. He now combines the positions of chairman and chief executive, giving him direct responsibility for strategy and management rather than a ceremonial family role.

The business remains rooted in petroleum refining, the activity that created the Vardinoyannis family fortune, while its current strategy extends across power, renewable energy and other energy services. That wider platform makes energy the clearest description of his present work. His executive authority is well established, but the precise distribution of ownership within the wider family remains separate from those operating duties.
